projectDesc.p: 提供されたナグ・ハマディ写本全文のテキストファイルを文書ごとに分け、サイト掲載に向けて下処理したものの TEI 版。訳と語釈はまだ付けていない。語群・形態素・品詞・レンマは 2026-11-24 に Coptic SCRIPTORIUM の NLP で自動で付けた暫定版で、人の目で確かめていない（editorialDecl の segmentation と interpretation）。下処理（文書の分割、変換の残骸の除去、ⲍ・ⲯ の復元）と TEI 化には生成 AI（Claude）を使い、結果が元ファイルと対応することを検証スクリプト（scripts/verify.py、scripts/verify_tei.py）で確かめた。

TEI version of the supplied full text of the Nag Hammadi Codices, divided into tractates and preprocessed for publication on the site. No translation or gloss has been added yet. Bound groups, morphemes, parts of speech and lemmata were assigned automatically with the Coptic SCRIPTORIUM NLP tools on 2026-11-24 and have not been checked by hand (see segmentation and interpretation in editorialDecl). The preprocessing (division into tractates, removal of conversion residue, restoration of ⲍ and ⲯ) and the TEI conversion were carried out with a generative AI model (Claude); the result was checked against the source file with the verification scripts (scripts/verify.py, scripts/verify_tei.py).

segmentation.p: s は元ファイルの 1 行（1 セグメント）。行が文書の境目や表題の境目をまたぐときだけ分けた。xml:id は「写本番号-行 ID」で、分けた行には「_開始トークン位置」（元ファイルの行の中での位置、0 始まり）を付けた。n は文書内の通し番号。w は、TEI にしたときは元ファイルの空白区切り（形態素解析器の出力とみられる）のままとし、ⲍ・ⲯ を戻した語が途中で切れていたときだけ 1 つにつないだ。いまの phr と w の区切りは次の段落のとおり。ab の type は title（冒頭表題）、text（本文）、subscript（奥書表題）、colophon（写字生の奥書・覚え書き）、fragment（未配置断片）。

Each s is one row (segment) of the source file; a row is split only where it straddles the boundary of a tractate or of a title. xml:id is the codex number followed by the row id; for split rows the position of the first token within the source row (counted from 0) is added after an underscore. n numbers the segments within the tractate. When the file was first encoded, each w was a token of the source file (apparently the output of a morphological segmenter), except that tokens were joined where a restored ⲍ or ⲯ fell inside a word that the segmenter had split; the present division into phr and w is described in the next paragraphs. The type of ab is title (opening title), text, subscript (subscript title), colophon (scribal colophon or note) or fragment (unplaced fragments).

2026-11-24 の注釈：phr は語群（正書法上の 1 語）、w は形態素。どちらも Coptic SCRIPTORIUM の NLP（https://tools.copticscriptorium.org/coptic-nlp/）が推定したもので、scripts/coptic_nlp_tei.py（groups=auto、laytonize=smart）で TEI に戻した。NLP には TEI にしたときの w（元ファイルの空白区切り）を空白で区切って送り、語群と形態素の区切りは NLP に任せた。2 つのセグメントにまたがって推定された語は、セグメントの境目で分けた。本文の文字、gap と supplied の位置、s の xml:id と n は変えていない（書き出す前にスクリプトが確かめた）。人の目では確かめていない。

Annotation of 2026-11-24: phr is the bound group (orthographic word) and w the morpheme, both as inferred by the Coptic SCRIPTORIUM NLP tools (https://tools.copticscriptorium.org/coptic-nlp/) and written back into the TEI by scripts/coptic_nlp_tei.py (groups=auto, laytonize=smart). The tools were given the w of the file as first encoded (the tokens of the source file) separated by spaces and decided the group and morpheme boundaries themselves; a word inferred across two segments was divided at the segment boundary. The letters of the text, the positions of gap and supplied, and the xml:id and n of each s are unchanged (checked by the script before writing). Not checked by hand.

correction.p: 元ファイルでは ⲝ がすべて ⲯ になっていたので、ⲝ に戻した（この文書では 10 字）。元ファイルで落ちていた ⲍ と ⲯ は、語形と文脈から語が決まる箇所で戻した（この文書では 29 語）。戻した字は supplied で包み、resp="#zp" と cert を付けた（w の resp と cert は形態素注釈のもの）。high（29 語）は語形と文脈から決まるもの、medium（0 語）は固有名など、校訂本や翻訳で知られている読みを当てたもの。どちらも校訂本とは照合していない。英語の編集注記が文字化けして残っていた箇所は、欠損の注記なので gap に置き換えた。変更は 1 か所ずつ、同梱の changes.tsv と restored_letters.tsv に記録してある。

In the source file every ⲝ had been converted to ⲯ; these were changed back to ⲝ (10 letters in this file). The letters ⲍ and ⲯ, lost throughout the source file, were restored where the word could be identified from its form and context (29 words in this file). The restored letters are enclosed in supplied with resp="#zp" and cert (the resp and cert of w belong to the morphological annotation): high (29) = determined by word form and context; medium (0) = proper names and similar words, restored following readings known from editions and translations. None has been collated with the printed editions. Garbled residue of English editorial notes, which reported lost text, was replaced by gap. Every change is listed in the accompanying files changes.tsv and restored_letters.tsv.

interpretation.p: 訳と語釈はまだ付けていない。品詞（type）、レンマ（lemma）、ギリシア語借用語の印（xml:lang="grc"）は、下の段落の自動注釈による暫定のもの。gap（reason="lost"。2026-11-24 に EpiDoc に合わせて "lacuna" から改めた）は、元ファイルに行・頁単位の欠損の注記があった位置を示す（この文書では 0 箇所）。それ以外の欠損と校訂者による復元の区別、下点、上線、句読点、頁と行の区切りは元ファイルになく、符号化していない。

No translation or gloss has been added yet. Part of speech (type), lemma (lemma) and loanword marking (xml:lang="grc") come from the provisional automatic annotation described below. gap with reason="lost" (changed from "lacuna" on 2026-11-24, following EpiDoc) marks the places where the source file had an editorial note reporting lost lines or pages (0 in this file). The source file does not distinguish other lacunae from editorial restorations and has no sublinear dots, supralinear strokes, punctuation, or page and line breaks; none of these is encoded.

2026-11-24 の注釈：w/@type（品詞）、w/@lemma（レンマ）、借用語の印（xml:lang="grc"）は、Coptic SCRIPTORIUM の NLP の出力をサイトの約束に合わせて書いたもの（style=site。PPERS・PPERO・PPERI は PPER、UNKNOWN と ACOND_PPERS のような融合したタグは X、人称代名詞と冠詞のレンマは NLP の正規化した語形）。w/@resp は "#coptic-nlp"。w/@cert は medium で、X の語、セグメントの境目で分けた語、文字の対応がずれた語は low。確度はスクリプトの目安で、正解率ではない。語釈（w/@ana）は付けていない。構文（依存関係）は TEI に入れず、../conllu/ の同じ名前のファイル（CoNLL-U）に出した。どれも人の目では確かめておらず、校訂版・辞書との照合を要する。

Annotation of 2026-11-24: w/@type (part of speech), w/@lemma and the loanword marking (xml:lang="grc") are the output of the Coptic SCRIPTORIUM NLP tools, written to the site's conventions (style=site: PPERS, PPERO and PPERI become PPER; UNKNOWN and fused tags such as ACOND_PPERS become X; personal pronouns and articles take the normalized form given by the tools as their lemma). w/@resp is "#coptic-nlp"; w/@cert is medium, or low for X, for words divided at a segment boundary and for words whose letters did not align; this is the script's own rating, not an accuracy. No glosses (w/@ana) have been added. The syntax (dependencies) is not encoded in the TEI; it is in the CoNLL-U file of the same name in ../conllu/. None of this has been checked by hand; all of it still has to be checked against the critical editions and dictionaries.

revisionDesc.change: TEI file generated from the preprocessed text (scripts/make_tei.py).
Published in the Sheneset repository and made searchable in the corpus search; publisher, licence and date stated in publicationStmt.

The restoration marks for ⲍ and ⲯ moved from the attributes of w to supplied (reason="lost-in-source-file", resp="#zp", the same cert) around the restored letters, as in the annotated files, so that the resp and cert of w can carry the morphological annotation.

Bound groups (phr), morphemes (w), part of speech (type) and lemmas of 946 segments annotated automatically with the Coptic SCRIPTORIUM NLP service by scripts/coptic_nlp_tei.py (groups=auto, laytonize=smart, style=site); resp="#coptic-nlp", not checked by hand. The letters of the text, the gaps, the supplied letters and the page and line breaks are unchanged.

Brought into line with the annotation specification (docs/ANNOTATION_SPEC.md): the subtitle, the token count in extent and the statements about the annotation in publicationStmt, projectDesc and editorialDecl brought up to date; the dependency analysis of the same NLP run written to ../conllu/07-1_paraphrase-of-shem.conllu. Carried out with a generative AI model (Claude).
